title: 30-day PSI plan
note: Default plan weighted toward Electrical Theory and Wiring & Protection (each ~29% of the exam). Day 30 lands on exam day when an exam date is set. Edit freely — progress is tracked per task.

days.title: Orientation + tab the book
tasks: Read Art. 90 (scope, how the Code is arranged) and skim Art. 100 definitions
Tab the NEC: Ch. 2, 3, 4 starts, Tables 310.16, 250.66, 250.122, 314.16, Ch. 9 Tables 1/4/5/8, Annex C (Avery Swift Tabs or Redi-Tag only)
Set exam date in the app and run a 10-question quick drill for a baseline

days.title: Ohm's law + power
tasks: Drill E=IR, P=IE, P=I²R, P=E²/R until each is automatic
Work 15 single-step problems: solve for the missing variable
Flashcards: Electrical Theory deck

days.title: Series, parallel, combination circuits
tasks: Series: total R, current, voltage across each resistor
Parallel: reciprocal and product-over-sum methods; equal resistors shortcut
Combination circuits: reduce step by step; Kirchhoff's voltage and current laws

days.title: AC fundamentals
tasks: Peak vs RMS (×1.414 / ×0.707), frequency, period
Impedance triangle: Z = √(R² + X²); XL and XC behavior with frequency
Power triangle: true W, apparent VA, reactive VAR, power factor

days.title: Three-phase + transformers
tasks: Wye vs delta: line/phase voltage and current relationships (√3)
3-phase power P = 1.732 × E × I × PF; kVA to amps both ways
Transformer turns ratio, primary/secondary current, kVA sizing

days.title: Branch circuits — Art. 210
tasks: Receptacle placement rules for dwellings (walls, countertops, bathrooms, garages, outdoors, hallways)
GFCI and AFCI required locations — make a two-column list
Continuous loads (125%), receptacle ratings per circuit size
Flashcards: Wiring & Protection deck

days.title: Week 1 review + baseline sim
tasks: Full 70-question timed simulation (baseline — don't skip the timer)
Review every miss; add a flashcard for each one in the app
Note weakest two topics on the dashboard

days.title: Feeders + load calcs I — Art. 215, 220
tasks: General lighting VA per square foot; small-appliance and laundry circuits
Demand factors for general lighting (Table 220.42)
Work 3 dwelling standard-method calcs end to end

days.title: Load calcs II — ranges, dryers, optional
tasks: Range demand (Table 220.55) and dryer demand (220.54)
Optional method for dwellings (220.82): what's at 100%, what's at 40%
Neutral load basics (220.61)

days.title: Services — Art. 230
tasks: Clearances for service drops and conductors (230.24, 230.9)
Service disconnect: location, max number, minimum ratings
When conductors are considered 'outside' a building (230.6)

days.title: Overcurrent protection — Art. 240
tasks: Standard OCPD ratings (240.6) and the next-size-up rule (240.4(B))
Small-conductor limits (240.4(D))
Tap rules: 10 ft and 25 ft (240.21(B))
OCPD location rules (240.24)

days.title: Grounding I — Art. 250 system grounding
tasks: Grounding electrode system: which electrodes, how they're bonded
Rod electrodes: supplemental rod rule, spacing
GEC sizing (Table 250.66) and installation (250.64)

days.title: Grounding II — bonding + EGCs
tasks: EGC sizing (Table 250.122) with the upsizing rule
Main bonding jumper and supply-side bonding jumper sizing (250.102(C))
Separate buildings (250.32) — where the neutral is and isn't bonded
Flashcards: catch up all due cards

days.title: Week 2 review
tasks: Two quick drills; re-work every missed calc by hand
Rewrite Table 250.66 and Table 250.122 from memory, then check
Flashcards until the due count hits zero

days.title: General wiring methods — Art. 300
tasks: Burial depths (Table 300.5) — memorize the common five
Protection from physical damage: 1¼ in. rule, steel plates
Free conductor length at boxes

days.title: Conductors — Art. 310
tasks: Table 310.16 ampacities: 14 AWG through 500 kcmil copper at 75°C
Adjustment for more than 3 current-carrying conductors (310.15(C))
Temperature correction (310.15(B)) and the 83% dwelling rule (310.12)
Work 5 derating problems ending with the OCPD choice

days.title: Boxes + fill — Art. 312, 314
tasks: Box fill volumes (Table 314.16(B)) and what counts as a conductor
Pull/junction box sizing: straight pulls (8×) and angle pulls (6× + others)
Box support and accessibility rules

days.title: Raceways + conduit fill
tasks: Securing/supporting intervals for RMC, IMC, EMT, FMC, PVC
Raceway fill: 53% / 31% / 40% and the 24-in. nipple rule
Practice 5 Annex C lookups and 3 Table 4/5 calculations
PVC expansion fittings (352.44)

days.title: Cables + cords
tasks: NM, AC, MC, SE, UF: uses permitted / not permitted, support intervals
NM ampacity limit (334.80)
Flexible cords: where they can't replace fixed wiring (400.12)

days.title: Devices + luminaires — Art. 404–410
tasks: Switch rules: grounded conductor at switch locations, mounting height
Receptacles: replacement rules, wet-location covers, tamper-resistant
Panelboard directory and ratings
Luminaires: bathtub zone, clothes closet clearances

days.title: Second full sim
tasks: Full 70-question timed simulation
Compare topic breakdown with the baseline — what moved?
Add a flashcard for every miss

days.title: Motors — Art. 430
tasks: Use the FLC tables, not nameplate, for conductors and OCPD
Branch-circuit conductors 125%; overloads 115%/125%
Short-circuit/ground-fault protection percentages (Table 430.52)
Disconnect rules: within sight, 115% rating

days.title: HVAC + transformers — Art. 440, 450
tasks: HVAC conductor and disconnect rules
Transformer primary OCPD percentages (Table 450.3(B))
Transformer location/ventilation basics
Flashcards: Equipment deck

days.title: Hazardous + special occupancies
tasks: Class I/II/III and Division 1/2 — definitions and examples
Seals: where and how close
Commercial garages and health-care patient bed locations

days.title: Pools, PV, emergency systems
tasks: Pool receptacle distances, luminaire depth, equipotential bonding
PV: max voltage, 125% current rule, rapid shutdown limits
Emergency (10 s) vs legally required standby (60 s); the 120% busbar rule

days.title: Voltage drop + conductor properties
tasks: VD = 2KIL/CM (single-phase) and 1.732KIL/CM (three-phase); K ≈ 12.9 Cu / 21.2 Al
Solve for voltage drop, then for minimum conductor size
Resistance vs length, area, temperature (Ch. 9 Table 8)

days.title: Theory calc sprint
tasks: 20 mixed theory problems under a 30-minute timer
Efficiency, horsepower/kW/kVA conversions, neutral current
Flashcards: Electrical Theory deck to zero due

days.title: Third full sim
tasks: Full 70-question timed simulation — treat it like the real day
Target: 80%+ overall, no topic under 70%
Quick drill on anything still weak

days.title: Weak-topic cleanup + logistics
tasks: Two quick drills on the dashboard's weakest topics
Confirm PSI appointment, ID, route to College Park, what you may bring (tabbed NEC 2020, permitted tab types only)
Re-check every tab; practice finding 10 random articles in under 20 seconds each

days.title: Exam day
tasks: Light flashcard pass only — no new material
Pace: 70 questions / 210 min = 3 min each; flag and move on
Eat, hydrate, arrive early
